parent_objective: M270 source-balanced objective plus M275 retention anchor plus M278 recovery anchor

public_gates: fixed sampled and exact M270 objective improvement
six replay surfaces if row16 passes
old protected-key diagnostic if replay passes
behavior seeds 9505 and 9506 if replay passes
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M279
do not use old checkpoint hidden states
do not promote based only on objective improvement
hypothesis: Adding the M278 current-hidden recovery anchor to the M270 objective and M275 retention anchor can improve objective while preserving row16 terminal-margin slack.
success_criteria: use M270 source-balanced objective and a combined trajectory anchor that keeps M275 retention while replacing recovered step0 targets with M278 recovery actions
run exactly one small actor-coupling update before any repeat or PPO
improve fixed M270 objective versus M272
preserve M183/M170 row16 terminal margin above the registered required floor
preserve all six replay surfaces, protected key, and behavior seeds if row16 passes
failure_criteria: row16 terminal margin crosses the registered floor
combined objective improves but row16 or replay surfaces regress
recovery anchor creates objective movement but loses behavior retention

commands.name: m279_combined_anchor
commands.command: Build runs/m279_combined_retention_recovery_anchor/combined_trajectory_anchor.npz by dropping M275 retention step0 rows whose source_index appears in M278 recovery_anchor.npz and appending M278 recovery rows repeated 16 times.

commands.name: m279_actor_update
commands.command: Run one small actor-coupling update from m272b_a0_01025 using M270 objective and the M279 combined retention/recovery trajectory anchor, then gate row16 before broader proof gates.

decision_rule: Reject M279 because exact objective and row16 improve but the refreshed M267/M264 current-family replay surface loses five wrong-history success drops. Protected-key and behavior gates are skipped because the replay proof tier already failed.
